This template is used in the system messages [[MediaWiki:Noarticletext]] and [[MediaWiki:Noarticletext-nopermission]] to display the message when a non-existent page is entered. The output depends on the type of page (article, template, talk page, etc.) and whether the user has the right to create the page or not.

== Usage ==
The template has an optional parameter ''nopermission'' to adjust the output when the user does not have permission to create the page.
